contract_plain_english: For the one-dimensional scalar advection equation with constant real velocity ū, the selected passage asserts that q(x,t) = q̃(x − ūt) supplies solutions for any profile q̃, and that the profile travels at velocity ū without changing shape [printed p. 1, (1.2)-(1.3) and surrounding text]. The passage does not explicitly restrict profile regularity or state a solution sense for nonsmooth profiles. The book later verifies this form for smooth functions and expressly distinguishes classical differential solutions from discontinuous solutions treated through conservation or weak formulations [printed pp. 4-5, section 1.1.2; printed pp. 17-18, (2.13); printed pp. 215-216, section 11.11]. Consequently, the source fixes the translation formula and propagation claim, while leaving the exact function class and nonsmooth interpretation of its introductory 'any function' wording unresolved.
